subject.character: ONE sleepy adult male koala; inky right paw; cowbell on his neck; on his belly a clear four-cup milking machine, hose dragging, gold discs gurgling along it; same face throughout
subject.anti_action: weary serious face, brisk dry talker; the mouth talks, never chews

second_characters: ONE magpie, at the bottom edge; ONE animator with a Halloween pumpkin head on a bicycle; ONE Koschei animator on a scooter: gaunt old man, long grey beard, spiked crown, black cloak
props: bark strips, cups, bucket, discs: blank
environment: eucalyptus grove as a milking yard: wooden stalls, buckets on hooks, hoses up the trunks; dense background
lighting: low sunset sun behind-left, gold glints; warm magenta sky glow behind-right, high contrast, bright; at 9.40 the sun flares
motion_rule: The camera orbits him in an arc every beat and changes shot size; stalls, buckets, hoses slide behind him, never still. He moves his whole body every beat.

audio.delivery: flat low brisk male voice, native, no accent; first word on frame one
audio.pacing: brisk, each line once, inside its beat, no speech after 7.3; silent beats: no voice, no moo

timeline.a: mouth opens on every syllable; he waddles round a stall post, as the magpie hops backward in the foreground with bark in its beak; camera arcs left
mouth opens on every syllable; he swings his body to the magpie, raising his inky paw, as it holds the bark higher; arc
mouth opens on every syllable; he lunges and slaps his paw on the bark, as the magpie flies back; camera arcs right
he flops down legs splayed, hose lashing, as discs gurgle along it and ring into a bucket; low arc
mouth opens on every syllable; he grabs the hose, heaves up and turns after it, hose big in the foreground; camera arcs
mouth opens on every syllable; he hugs the hose like a trunk and spins with it; camera orbits back
mouth opens on every syllable; he turns, slapping both paws on the machine, belly bouncing; camera arcs
mouth opens on every syllable; he climbs halfway up a trunk, as the magpie flies to a branch with fresh bark; arc round the trunk
mouth opens on every syllable; he slides down the trunk on his belly, as discs stream along the hose past the camera; camera arcs down
by habit he slaps his inky paw on the bark again, as the magpie shoves it under his paw; short arc
medium; he lurches sideways, as the pumpkin-head animator rides in from the left on a bicycle, big in the foreground, plugging two hosed cups into him on the move; arc round the bicycle
medium; he sways the other way, cowbell clanging, as the Koschei animator rides in from the right on a scooter, big in the foreground, plugging two more hosed cups into him on the move; arc back
medium; he staggers forward step by step, knees buckling, hoses dragging, rocking, as both animators ride at his sides, keeping pace; camera orbits

must_appear: 7.30 he signs the bark again by habit; 7.90 pumpkin-head animator plugs two cups into him; 8.60 Koschei animator plugs two more; final: koala barely trudging, hoses dragging, animators at his sides
negative_prompt: small hero, static camera, a still background, text, letters, digits, subtitles, watermark, pouch, joey, duplicate koalas, duplicate props, chewing while speaking, koala riding the bicycle or scooter, more than two animators, a hero walking at the camera, gaze in the lens, darkness, floating objects, a line said twice, foreign accent, mooing
